top_signals.title: Gold Set for Best Week Since January on Support From Dip-Buyers
top_signals.summary: Gold was on track for its biggest gain in more than six months as dip-buyers supported prices above a key technical level while looking past flare-ups in the Strait of Hormuz that risked adding to energy-led inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
